The source document is registered in `sources/index.yaml` as `gr-202407031335114330` (date 2024-07-03).

Do this:
1. Read CLAUDE.md (the rulebook rules), the change set, and the files of the affected scheme(s): mh.ladki_bahin.
2. Apply every change in the change set, following CLAUDE.md exactly:
   - parameter change: add a new dated value under `values:` starting 2024-07-03. Never edit or delete older values.
   - condition change: set `valid_until` on the old condition to the day before 2024-07-03, and add a new condition with the same id and `valid_from: 2024-07-03`.
   - condition removed: only set `valid_until` to the day before 2024-07-03.
   - every new value or condition gets `source` / `metadata.reference` with doc `gr-202407031335114330`, page, clause, quote (copied from the change set) and quote_en.
   - if a change needs a new person field, add it to `schema/person.yaml` with a safe default that keeps existing results unchanged.
3. Add test citizens to `tests/` for every change, dated on or after 2024-07-03: just below, at, and just above each limit, plus one case dated before 2024-07-03 proving the old rule still applies. Each case cites `GR 202407031335114330 p.<page> clause <clause>` in `source`.
4. Add an entry at the top of CHANGELOG.md (English, Hindi, Marathi) linking to the document.
5. Run `python -m niyam_rulebook test` and fix problems until it prints `0 failed` with no PROBLEM lines.
6. Do not run git. Do not edit files outside schemes/, parameters/, tests/, sources/, glossary/, schema/ and CHANGELOG.md.

Finish with a short summary of what you changed and the final test result.

input.command: cat .niyam/changeset.json; ls schemes/* parameters/*/* tests/*; cat schemes/mh/ladki_bahin.yaml; head -30 CHANGELOG.md; cat schema/person.yaml

6	## Baseline: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (GR dated 28 June 2024)
7	
8	- English: The scheme starts. Women aged 21 to 60 in Maharashtra, from families earning up to Rs 2.5 lakh a year, can get Rs 1,500 a month.
9	- हिंदी: योजना शुरू हुई। महाराष्ट्र की 21 से 60 वर्ष की महिलाएं, जिनके परिवार की वार्षिक आय 2.5 लाख रुपये तक है, हर महीने 1,500 रुपये पा सकती हैं।
10	- मराठी: योजना सुरू झाली. महाराष्ट्रातील 21 ते 60 वयोगटातील महिला, ज्यांच्या कुटुंबाचे वार्षिक उत्पन्न 2.5 लाख रुपयांपर्यंत आहे, त्यांना दरमहा 1,500 रुपये मिळू शकतात.
11	- Source: [GR 202406281814018230](https://gr.maharashtra.gov.in/Site/Upload/Government%20Resolutions/Marathi/202406281814018230.pdf)

## Amendments to Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (GR dated 3 July 2024)

- English: From 3 July 2024 women up to age 65 (earlier 60) can apply. One unmarried woman per family is now eligible. Contract workers in a family no longer disqualify it (regular employees and pensioners still do). A woman getting Rs 1,500 or more a month from other government schemes is not eligible (earlier, only more than Rs 1,500). The limit on family farm land of five acres is removed.
- हिंदी: 3 जुलाई 2024 से 65 वर्ष तक की महिलाएं (पहले 60) आवेदन कर सकती हैं। प्रत्येक परिवार की एक अविवाहित महिला अब पात्र है। परिवार में संविदा कर्मचारी होने से अब अपात्रता नहीं होगी (नियमित कर्मचारी और पेंशनधारी अब भी अपात्र हैं)। अन्य सरकारी योजनाओं से हर महीने 1,500 रुपये या अधिक पाने वाली महिला पात्र नहीं है (पहले केवल 1,500 रुपये से अधिक पर)। परिवार की पांच एकड़ कृषि भूमि की सीमा हटा दी गई है।
- मराठी: 3 जुलै 2024 पासून 65 वर्षांपर्यंतच्या महिला (पूर्वी 60) अर्ज करू शकतात. कुटुंबातील केवळ एक अविवाहित महिला आता पात्र आहे. कुटुंबात कंत्राटी कर्मचारी असल्यास आता अपात्रता नाही (नियमित कर्मचारी व निवृत्तीवेतनधारक अजूनही अपात्र). इतर शासकीय योजनांमधून दरमहा 1,500 रुपये किंवा अधिक लाभ घेणारी महिला पात्र नाही (पूर्वी केवळ 1,500 रुपयांपेक्षा जास्त असल्यास). कुटुंबाच्या पाच एकर शेतजमिनीची मर्यादा वगळली आहे.
- Source: [GR 202407031335114330](https://gr.maharashtra.gov.in/Site/Upload/Government%20Resolutions/Marathi/202407031335114330.pdf)

## Baseline: Mukhyamantri

content.text:
I applied all six changes from GR 202407031335114330 (effective 2024-07-03). `python -m niyam_rulebook test` finishes with `tests: 45 passed, 0 failed` and no PROBLEM lines.

- **Maximum age (c1):** `age_max` has a new dated value of 65, so women aged 65 are now eligible.
- **Marital statuses (c2):** `eligible_marital_statuses` now includes `unmarried`.
- **One unmarried woman per family (c3):** I added a new condition `unmarried_one_per_family`. It needed no new person field, because `other_unmarried_beneficiary_in_family` was already in `schema/person.yaml` with a default of false.
- **Government jobs (c4):** `disqualifying_govt_jobs` is now `[regular, pensioner]`, so a contract employee in the family no longer disqualifies.
- **Other-scheme limit (c5):** The old `other_scheme_limit` condition now ends 2024-07-02. A new one with the same id starts 2024-07-03 and uses `<` instead of `<=`, so receiving exactly Rs 1,500 now disqualifies.
- **Farm land (c6):** `farm_land_limit` now ends 2024-07-02, so there is no farm-land limit from 2024-07-03.
- **Sources and changelog:** Every new value and condition cites the new GR with page, clause, quote and English quote. `CHANGELOG.md` has a new entry at the top in English, Hindi and Marathi, linking to the GR. The document was already registered in `sources/index.yaml`.
- **Tests:** I added 20 cases to `tests/mh/ladki_bahin.yaml`. Each change has cases just below, at and just above its limit, plus a case dated 2024-07-02 showing the old rule still applies. All of them cite `GR 202407031335114330 p.2` and the clause.

The change set flags two ambiguities in clause 5(3) and 6(4). I followed its recommended reading, and the Rs 2.50 lakh income cap is still enforced by the existing income condition. I did not model the ration-card income-certificate exemption.
